verdict: Paid campaigns are paused; only organic presence is active this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, both Meta and Google Ads recorded zero spend, zero clicks, and zero leads — paid channels are fully off. Your Google Business Profile was the only active source of engagement, generating 31 actions including 2 calls, 14 direction requests, and 15 website clicks. Separately, website traffic dropped 43.75% week over week, and Google Business Profile engagement has been near zero for the last four days after a spike on August 25th — organic interest is softening. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore lead flow, and we expect new activity to be reflected in next week's numbers.
